tools.name: navi_get_pools
tools.description: Get all NAVI lending pools with supply/borrow rates, TVL, oracle prices, incentive APY, and token info

tools.name: navi_get_pool
tools.description: Get a specific lending pool by coin type, symbol, or asset ID

identifier.description: Coin type (e.g. 0x2::sui::SUI), symbol (e.g. SUI), or asset ID (e.g. 0)

tools.name: navi_get_protocol_stats
tools.description: Get NAVI protocol statistics: TVL, total borrow, utilization, max APY, user count, borrow fee

tools.name: navi_get_health_factor
tools.description: Get a user's lending health factor (> 1 is safe, <= 1 risks liquidation)

tools.name: navi_get_borrow_fee
tools.description: Get the protocol borrow fee rate and fee recipient address

tools.name: navi_get_fees
tools.description: Get detailed protocol fee breakdown: total fees, V3 borrow fees, interest fees, flash loan and liquidation fees

tools.name: navi_get_flash_loan_assets
tools.description: Get all assets available for flash loans with max amounts and fee rates

tools.name: navi_get_flash_loan_asset
tools.description: Get a specific flash loan asset by coin type, symbol, or asset ID

identifier.description: Coin type (e.g. 0x2::sui::SUI), symbol (e.g. SUI), or asset ID (e.g. 0)

tools.name: navi_get_lending_rewards
tools.description: Get a user's claimed lending reward history

tools.name: navi_get_available_rewards
tools.description: Get a user's available (unclaimed) lending rewards with summary by asset

tools.name: navi_get_price_feeds
tools.description: Get all oracle price feed configurations including Pyth and Supra feed IDs

tools.name: get_positions
tools.description: Get a user's DeFi positions across multiple protocols on Sui (navi, suilend, wallet, native-staking, volo, momentum, cetus, alphafi, bluefin, magma, scallop, ember, current, zo). Returns slim CSV data by default (set format to "json" for JSON). Columns: id, protocol, type, market, tokenASymbol, tokenAPrice, amountA, tokenBSymbol, tokenBPrice, amountB, valueUSD, apr, liquidationThreshold, lowerPrice, upperPrice, currentPrice, claimableRewards, isActive, vaultName.

protocols.description: Comma-separated protocol names to query. Supported: navi, suilend, wallet, native-staking, volo, momentum, cetus, alphafi, bluefin, magma, scallop, ember, current, zo. Defaults to "navi" if omitted.

format.description: Response format: csv (default, compact) or json

tools.name: navi_get_swap_quote
tools.description: Get a DEX aggregator swap quote for token exchange on Sui. Returns optimal routes across Cetus, Turbos, DeepBook, Aftermath, etc.

fromCoin.description: Source token symbol or coin type address (e.g. 'SUI' or '0x2::sui::SUI')

toCoin.description: Target token symbol or coin type address (e.g. 'USDC' or '0xdba...::usdc::USDC')

amount.description: Human-readable amount (e.g. 1 for 1 SUI, 100 for 100 USDC)

tools.name: navi_get_bridge_chains
tools.description: Get all blockchain networks supported by NAVI Astros Bridge (Sui, Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, Avalanche, Arbitrum)

tools.name: navi_search_bridge_tokens
tools.description: Search for tokens available for cross-chain bridging on a specific chain

tokenAddress.description: Token contract address or coin type to search for

tools.name: navi_get_bridge_quote
tools.description: Get a cross-chain bridge quote for transferring tokens between chains

tools.name: navi_get_bridge_tx_status
tools.description: Check the status of a cross-chain bridge transaction (processing, completed, fail)

tools.name: navi_get_bridge_history
tools.description: Get a wallet's cross-chain bridge transaction history

tools.name: navi_get_dca_orders
tools.description: Get a user's Dollar-Cost Averaging (DCA) orders with pagination and status filter

tools.name: navi_get_dca_order_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific DCA order including execution history and progress

tools.name: navi_list_dca_orders
tools.description: List DCA orders with optional status and creator filters

tools.name: navi_get_coins
tools.description: Get all coin balances for a Sui wallet address, aggregated by coin type

tools.name: navi_get_market_config
tools.description: Get NAVI market configuration including supported pools, EModes, and fee settings

tools.name: sui_get_transaction
tools.description: Get the full raw Sui transaction data by digest (hash), including inputs, effects, events, balance changes, and object changes

tools.name: sui_get_transaction_v2
tools.description: Get the Sui SDK v2 GraphQL/Core raw transaction shape by digest. Use this for new clients that do not require legacy JSON-RPC response compatibility.

tools.name: sui_explain_transaction
tools.description: Get a structured human-readable explanation of a Sui transaction: operation type, sender, gas cost, Move calls, balance changes with token symbols & amounts, object changes, and events

tools.name: navi_search_tokens
tools.description: Search for tokens/coins by keyword to get price, decimals, coin type, symbol. Fuzzy matches against coin type address or token symbol. Returns CSV format.

keyword.description: Search keyword to match against coin type or symbol (e.g. 'SUI', 'USDC', '0x2::sui::SUI')

tools.name: volo_get_vaults
tools.description: Get all VOLO yield vaults on Sui as CSV. Returns: id, name, protocol, status, riskLevel, instantAPR, apy7d, apy30d, totalStaked, totalStakedUsd, minInvestment, stakeCapAmount, coinPrice, exchangeRate, targetApy, startAt, endAt, lockupStartAt, lockupEndAt. Use this to browse available vaults and find vault IDs for detailed queries.

tools.name: volo_get_vault
tools.description: Get full details of a specific VOLO yield vault by ID, including APR, risk level, TVL, stake cap, coin price, exchange rate, lockup period, and dynamic fields. Use volo_get_vaults first to find the vault ID.

tools.name: volo_get_vault_apy_history
tools.description: Get historical APY (Annual Percentage Yield) data points for a VOLO vault over a specified time period. Returns timestamped APY values for trend analysis.

period.description: Time period for historical data: 1w (1 week), 1m (1 month), 1y (1 year)

tools.name: volo_get_vault_share_price_history
tools.description: Get historical share price data for a VOLO vault over a specified time period. Share price reflects the vault's underlying asset value per share and indicates accumulated yield over time.

period.description: Time period for historical data: 1w (1 week), 1m (1 month), 1y (1 year)

tools.name: volo_get_vault_tvl_history
tools.description: Get historical Total Value Locked (TVL) data for a specific VOLO vault. Returns timestamped TVL values showing how much capital is deposited in the vault over time.

period.description: Time period for historical data: 1w (1 week), 1m (1 month), 1y (1 year)

tools.name: volo_get_vault_system_summary
tools.description: Get VOLO vault platform-wide summary: total TVL across all vaults and total revenue generated in USD. Use this for a high-level overview of the VOLO vault ecosystem.

tools.name: volo_get_vault_total_tvl_history
tools.description: Get historical Total Value Locked (TVL) across all VOLO vaults combined. Returns timestamped TVL values for tracking overall platform growth.

period.description: Time period for historical data: 1w (1 week), 1m (1 month), 1y (1 year)

tools.name: volo_get_vault_user_positions
tools.description: Get a user's active positions across all VOLO vaults. Returns per-vault data: share balance, USD value, vault APR, and lifetime yield earned. Use this to see what a wallet has staked in VOLO.

tools.name: volo_get_vault_user_status
tools.description: Get a user's aggregated VOLO vault status: total deposited USD, lifetime yield earned in USD, and 7-day yield in USD. A quick summary of a wallet's overall VOLO vault performance.

tools.name: volo_get_vault_user_transactions
tools.description: Get a user's VOLO vault transaction history (stake/unstake) with pagination. Returns: txId, vaultId, type, amount, amountUsd, shares, status, and executeTime.

order.description: Sort order: desc (newest first) or asc (oldest first)

type.description: Filter by transaction type: stake (deposit) or unstake (withdraw)

tools.name: navi_get_portfolio_pnl
tools.description: Get a user's NAVI lending portfolio PnL (Profit & Loss): net worth, cumulative PnL, monthly PnL with percentage, and historical chart data

period.description: Time period for chart data: 7D/1W (1 week, default), 30D/1M (1 month), 15D (15 days), 6M (6 months)

tools.name: navi_get_vault_positions
tools.description: Get a wallet's Lending Vault positions across NAVI and Volo-backed vault sources. Returns positions with vaultId, source, protocol, shares, token balance/value, coin price, APR, lifetime yield, plus fetch time and per-source health.
